/* WORLD 1.2 — premium operational hierarchy. UI remains entirely original code. */
.aftershock-mission{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#09121d,#101e2b 65%,#111720)!important;border-color:rgba(108,169,199,.35)!important;grid-column:1/-1;min-height:320px!important}
.aftershock-mission .mission-card-body{min-height:320px;max-width:760px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.aftershock-mission h2{font-size:clamp(43px,5.3vw,82px);line-height:.91;letter-spacing:-.075em;margin:24px 0}
.ice{color:#a1e4f5}
.aftershock-signal{position:absolute;right:5%;top:0;bottom:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:25px;opacity:.55;transform:skew(-13deg)}
.aftershock-signal i{display:block;height:230px;width:5px;background:linear-gradient(0deg,transparent,#67cfee,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 45px #3f9fc5,0 0 120px #2d86b8;transform:rotate(11deg)}
.aftershock-signal i:nth-child(2){height:310px;width:9px;opacity:.8}.aftershock-signal i:nth-child(3){height:160px;opacity:.6}
.aftershock-mission .button-primary{background:#bce9f4;color:#04131d}.aftershock-mission .button-primary:hover{background:#f0fcff}
.mission-record{color:#a4bac8;font-size:12px;font-weight:680;letter-spacing:.06em;margin:20px 0 10px;min-height:18px}
.debrief-section{margin:6px clamp(28px,6.8vw,125px) 38px;padding:35px 43px 39px;border:1px solid rgba(155,190,207,.28);background:linear-gradient(112deg,#101b25,#0a1119 60%,#10151d)}
.debrief-body{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;align-items:end;margin:22px 0}
.debrief-outcome{font-size:clamp(43px,6vw,89px);letter-spacing:-.075em;line-height:.94;font-weight:870;display:block}
.debrief-body p{color:#a8bdc8;line-height:1.5;margin:13px 0 0}
.debrief-score{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:5px;color:#a6bcc8;font-size:11px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:.1em;white-space:nowrap}
.debrief-score strong{color:#f4f9fc;font-size:clamp(32px,4.2vw,67px);letter-spacing:-.06em}
body.text-large .hero-description,body.text-large .page-intro p,body.text-large .mission-card p,body.text-large .feature-grid p,body.text-large .setting span,body.text-large .settings-explainer,body.text-large .settings-note{font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,20px)!important;line-height:1.6}
body.text-large .nav button,body.text-large .world-header button,body.text-large .mission-record,body.text-large .mission-card .kicker,body.text-large .settings-panel .setting strong{font-size:15px}
body.text-large button{min-height:44px}body.text-large .run-entry{font-size:15px}
@media(max-width:630px){.aftershock-mission{min-height:410px!important}.aftershock-mission .mission-card-body{min-height:410px;padding:31px 24px}.aftershock-mission h2{font-size:clamp(39px,9vw,64px)}.aftershock-signal{right:-16%;opacity:.25}.debrief-section{margin:6px 22px 26px;padding:26px 22px}.debrief-body{align-items:start;flex-direction:column}.debrief-score{align-items:start}.mission-record{font-size:11px}}

/* WORLD 1.3 / SECTOR 12 — physical additional location, minimal typography. */
.sector12-mission{grid-column:1/-1!important;min-height:340px!important;
 background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 29%,rgba(100,155,219,.16),transparent 54%),linear-gradient(115deg,#08121a,#0d202a 66%,#121324)!important;
 border-color:rgba(135,204,236,.29)!important}

.sector12-mission .button-primary{color:#09131c;background:#caedfa}
.sector12-lines{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.63;overflow:hidden}
.sector12-lines:before{content:'12';position:absolute;right:1%;top:-15%;font-size:clamp(260px,40vw,620px);font-weight:900;line-height:1;color:rgba(164,220,251,.075);letter-spacing:-.09em}
.sector12-lines:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(145deg,transparent 0,transparent 65px,rgba(131,185,218,.08) 66px,transparent 67px);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 28%,black 100%)}
.sector12-lines i{position:absolute;right:10%;width:30%;height:2px;background:#9ce4ff;box-shadow:0 0 45px #70cdff;transform:rotate(-16deg)}
.sector12-lines i:nth-child(1){top:28%}.sector12-lines i:nth-child(2){top:42%;right:8%;background:#bb94ff}.sector12-lines i:nth-child(3){top:56%;right:12%}
@media(max-width:630px){.sector12-mission{min-height:455px!important}.sector12-mission .mission-card-body{min-height:455px;padding:34px 23px}.sector12-mission h2{font-size:clamp(49px,11vw,70px)}.sector12-lines{opacity:.20}}

/* WORLD 1.4 / MONOLITH — oversized editorial type, restrained operational rails.
 * No decorative 3rd party images and no hidden interactive areas. */
.campaign{padding:68px clamp(28px,6.8vw,125px) 84px;background:#070d14;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.campaign-intro{max-width:760px}.campaign-intro h2{font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,96px);line-height:.93;letter-spacing:-.075em;margin:23px 0 20px;font-weight:880}
.campaign-intro p{color:#a3b6c0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;max-width:560px}
.campaign-sequence{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:38px}
.campaign-node{display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;gap:15px;min-height:178px;background:#0c151e;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid rgba(175,201,216,.21);padding:20px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s,background .2s}
.campaign-node:hover,.campaign-node:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:#b3dce7;background:#122331;outline-offset:3px}
.campaign-number{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#94aab7}.campaign-node strong{font-size:clamp(16px,1.3vw,21px);font-weight:820;letter-spacing:-.045em;line-height:1.1}
.campaign-status{color:#9ab4c4;margin-top:auto;font-size:10px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:.055em}.campaign-node.completed{border-color:#80b7ac}.campaign-node.completed .campaign-status{color:#98e0b9}
.gridshadow-mission{grid-column:1/-1;min-height:400px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 86% 35%,rgba(245,136,82,.13),transparent 40%),linear-gradient(120deg,#080c12,#131c24 72%,#1b171c)!important;border:1px solid rgba(242,168,120,.33)!important;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.gridshadow-mission .mission-card-body{max-width:855px;min-height:400px;position:relative;z-index:2}.gridshadow-mission h2{font-size:clamp(53px,7.4vw,120px);letter-spacing:-.09em;line-height:.86;margin:24px 0 30px}
.gridshadow-mission h2 .light{color:#f6b58b}.gridshadow-mission h2 small{display:block;font-size:clamp(14px,1.6vw,21px);letter-spacing:.19em;line-height:1.45;margin-top:13px;color:#9fc8d8}
.gridshadow-mission .button-primary{background:#f4b28d;color:#140d0b}.gridshadow-mission .button-primary:hover{background:#ffdabd}
.gridshadow-art{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.65;overflow:hidden}
.gridshadow-art:before{content:'13';position:absolute;right:2%;top:-10%;font-size:clamp(260px,37vw,570px);font-weight:900;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.12em;color:rgba(250,167,122,.075)}
.gridshadow-art:after{content:'';position:absolute;right:0;inset-block:0;width:47%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(150deg,transparent 0 58px,rgba(248,164,118,.09) 59px,transparent 60px);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#000)}
.gridshadow-art i{position:absolute;right:9%;height:2px;width:30%;background:#eead82;box-shadow:0 0 32px #e89b71;transform:rotate(-12deg)}
.gridshadow-art i:nth-child(1){top:28%}.gridshadow-art i:nth-child(2){top:43%;right:12%;background:#84d4e5}.gridshadow-art i:nth-child(3){top:60%;right:8%}
.history-tools{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:end;padding:10px 0 25px}
.history-tools label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;color:#9cb4c2;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.055em}
.history-tools select,.history-export{height:46px;background:#101b24;border:1px solid rgba(180,209,226,.27);color:#eff4f7;padding:0 15px;min-width:140px;cursor:pointer}
.history-export{font-size:11px;font-weight:780;letter-spacing:.06em}.history-export:hover{background:#1e303b}

@media(max-width:630px){.campaign{padding:55px 22px 60px}.campaign-intro h2{font-size:clamp(43px,12vw,67px)}.campaign-sequence{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.campaign-node{min-height:135px;padding:16px}.campaign-node strong{font-size:16px}.gridshadow-mission{min-height:480px!important}.gridshadow-mission .mission-card-body{padding:35px 24px;min-height:480px}.gridshadow-mission h2{font-size:clamp(46px,11vw,72px)}.history-tools{gap:10px}.history-tools label{flex:1 1 135px}.history-tools select{width:100%;min-width:0}.history-export{width:100%}}

/* MONOLITH 1.5: North-wing editorial card. No raster assets, no extra controls. */
.signalfall-mission{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-color:rgba(156,215,237,.32);background:linear-gradient(120deg,#101b25,#08121e 75%);}
.signalfall-art{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto auto;width:45%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;opacity:.43;background:radial-gradient(circle at 60% 45%,rgba(105,194,221,.17),transparent 56%);}

.signalfall-art i:nth-child(2){width:39%;border-style:dashed;opacity:.75;}

.signalfall-mission .mission-card-body{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:650px;}
.signalfall-mission h2{font-size:clamp(40px,5.8vw,88px);letter-spacing:-.065em;line-height:.95;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}

@media(max-width:600px){.signalfall-art{width:65%;opacity:.19}.signalfall-mission h2{font-size:clamp(36px,12vw,58px)}.signalfall-mission .mission-card-body{max-width:100%}}

/* WORLD 1.8 / PRESSURE ECHO: MONOLITH architectural card, authored CSS. */
.pressureecho-mission{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0c1522 0%,#111f2b 61%,#111a25 100%);border-color:rgba(165,205,219,.17)}
.pressureecho-art{position:absolute;right:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:43%;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;opacity:.68;background:repeating-linear-gradient(112deg,transparent 0 28px,rgba(145,188,205,.04) 29px 31px,transparent 32px 52px)}
.pressureecho-art:before{content:'';position:absolute;top:13%;right:19%;height:66%;width:43%;border:11px solid rgba(134,193,206,.23);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 17px rgba(156,202,211,.05),inset 0 0 50px rgba(247,151,108,.10)}
.pressureecho-art i{position:absolute;display:block;left:17%;width:66%;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(235,158,125,.85),transparent);transform:rotate(-17deg)}
.pressureecho-art i:nth-child(1){top:32%}.pressureecho-art i:nth-child(2){top:51%}.pressureecho-art i:nth-child(3){top:70%}
.pressureecho-art span{position:absolute;right:8%;bottom:8%;font:600 clamp(32px,4vw,70px)/1 monospace;letter-spacing:-.09em;color:rgba(163,214,225,.24)}
.pressureecho-mission .mission-card-body{position:relative;z-index:1}.pressureecho-mission .kicker{color:#bdcdd6}

</style>
<style>/* SABLEFAULT WORLD 2.5 / BLACKBOX. Source-authored interface, no decorative image assets. */
.incident-blackbox[hidden]{display:none!important}
.incident-blackbox{margin:0 clamp(22px,6.8vw,125px) 70px;border:1px solid rgba(150,190,205,.28);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0c161e,#101f29 70%,#10171e);padding:clamp(22px,4vw,52px);color:#edf3f6}
.incident-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.incident-heading h2{font-weight:870;font-size:clamp(37px,5.6vw,83px);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.07em;margin:19px 0 15px}
.incident-heading p{font-size:13px;color:#bdd3df;font-weight:720;letter-spacing:.07em}
.incident-controls{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.incident-controls button,.incident-open{min-height:42px;border:1px solid rgba(178,212,225,.36);background:rgba(142,191,208,.07);color:#f0f6f9;padding:0 16px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.08em}
.incident-controls button:hover,.incident-open:hover,.incident-controls button:focus-visible,.incident-open:focus-visible{background:rgba(153,218,239,.19);border-color:#b2e5f5}
.incident-overview{margin:35px 0 28px;padding-top:21px;border-top:1px solid rgba(152,192,210,.2)}
.incident-overview>span{color:#aec4d1;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em}
.incident-overview>span strong{color:#fff;font-size:16px;margin-left:6px}
.incident-metrics{margin-top:19px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.incident-metric{min-width:0;padding:19px 17px;border:1px solid rgba(134,180,196,.18);background:#0a131b;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.incident-metric span{font-size:10px;color:#9cb6c4;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:750}
.incident-metric strong{font-size:clamp(27px,3.4vw,46px);font-weight:830;line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.06em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.incident-timeline-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:25px 0 14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(152,192,210,.2)}
.incident-timeline-head h3{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.15em;font-weight:820;margin:0}.incident-timeline-head span{font-size:11px;color:#afc5d2}
.incident-timeline{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0 30px}
.incident-event{display:grid;grid-template-columns:58px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;align-items:baseline;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(147,185,204,.14);font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:#d2e1e8}
.incident-event time{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#90aebb;font-size:11px;font-weight:770;letter-spacing:.1em}.incident-event.warning span{color:#f5c3ac}.incident-event.good span{color:#9be2bf}
.incident-empty{color:#9eb4bf;font-size:13px;padding:12px 0}.incident-disclaimer{color:#93aab5;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;margin:23px 0 0}
.run-entry{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1.1fr auto auto;gap:12px;align-items:center}.incident-open{min-height:37px;padding:0 13px}
@media(max-width:700px){.incident-blackbox{margin:0 16px 45px;padding:22px 18px}.incident-heading h2{font-size:clamp(34px,9vw,57px)}.incident-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.incident-timeline{grid-template-columns:1fr}.incident-controls{width:100%}.incident-controls button{flex:1 1 130px}.run-entry{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}.run-entry>span:nth-child(3){grid-column:1}.run-entry b{grid-column:2}.incident-open{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%}}
@media(max-width:360px){.incident-blackbox{margin-inline:12px;padding:19px 14px}.incident-metric{padding:13px}.incident-metric strong{font-size:27px}}
</style>
<style>/* WORLD 2.7 / FLIGHT RECORDER. Authored responsive UI; no image layers. */
.flight-desk[hidden]{display:none!important}
.flight-desk{margin-top:34px;padding:clamp(18px,3vw,32px);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 72% -10%,rgba(33,117,137,.15),transparent 48%),#09131b;border:1px solid rgba(138,196,216,.30);color:#f1f7fb}
.flight-desk-heading{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.flight-desk-heading h3{font-size:clamp(23px,3vw,38px);font-weight:820;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:8px 0 6px;line-height:1.1}
.flight-desk-heading p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:#bed3df;margin:0}
.flight-desk-heading label{font-size:12px;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#b7d2e0;display:grid;gap:9px;min-width:175px}
.flight-desk-heading select{min-height:46px;padding:0 13px;background:#132532;color:#f4f8fb;border:1px solid #638394;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer}
.flight-graph-shell{margin:24px 0 17px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(130,177,197,.23);background:#08131d}
#flightGraph{width:100%;height:250px;display:block;overflow:visible}
.flight-readout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:19px}
.flight-readout>div{background:#101f2b;padding:17px 20px;border:1px solid rgba(147,202,221,.13);display:grid;gap:10px}
.flight-readout span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#a9bdca;font-weight:700}
.flight-readout strong{font:780 clamp(24px,3vw,38px)/1.2 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.06em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#fff}
.flight-range-label{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#a9cad9;margin-bottom:12px}
#flightScrub{width:100%;height:28px;margin:0;accent-color:#7dd7ed;cursor:pointer}
#flightScrub:focus-visible,.flight-actions button:focus-visible,.flight-desk-heading select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #c5f2ff;outline-offset:3px}
.flight-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:17px}
.flight-actions button{min-height:48px;padding:11px 19px;border:1px solid #79abc2;color:#f3f9fc;background:#153344;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.025em;font-weight:780;cursor:pointer}
.flight-actions button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#215269;border-color:#b9ecfa}
.flight-actions button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.flight-actions span{font-size:12px;color:#d2bba0}
.incident-event.already-recorded{background:rgba(95,170,202,.07)}
.incident-event.already-recorded time{color:#dbf6ff}
.incident-timeline-head h3{font-size:16px}
.incident-event{font-size:14px}
.incident-event time{font-size:13px}
.incident-disclaimer{font-size:13px;color:#b9cad2}
@media(max-width:650px){.flight-desk{padding:17px 14px;margin-top:22px}.flight-desk-heading{gap:16px}.flight-desk-heading label{width:100%}#flightGraph{height:185px}.flight-readout{gap:6px}.flight-readout>div{padding:13px 9px;gap:8px}.flight-readout span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0}.flight-readout strong{font-size:clamp(20px,6vw,28px)}.flight-actions button{width:100%}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#flightGraph *{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}
</style>
<style>/* SABLEFAULT WORLD 2.8 / CRISIS COMMAND + local-only intelligence.
   Real markup/CSS: no generated imagery, no fake telemetry or external fonts. */
.command-deck{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:15px;margin-top:20px;color:#f7f9fb}
.command-column{min-width:0;min-height:292px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;padding:clamp(23px,3vw,40px);border:1px solid rgba(160,207,221,.28);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(21,40,50,.95),rgba(9,18,27,.98));position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.command-column:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#86deec,transparent 85%);opacity:.75}
.command-daily{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 0,rgba(217,157,92,.12),transparent 54%),linear-gradient(145deg,#1b2229,#0b131d)}
.command-daily:before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f0c18b,transparent 82%)}
.command-kicker{color:#b9d5df;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.09em;font-weight:750;line-height:1.4}
.command-daily-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%}
.command-daily-head time{font-size:13px;color:#dfb99a;font-weight:720;white-space:nowrap}
.command-progress{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;margin-top:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.command-progress strong{font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,54px);font-weight:760;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.045em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.command-progress span{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:#b7c6d0}
.command-meter{width:100%;height:6px;background:#273a44;margin:16px 0 25px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:4px}
.command-meter span{display:block;width:0;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#63b4ca,#a4f1d7);transition:width .28s ease;border-radius:4px}
.command-muted{font-size:11px;color:#a5bfca;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:760}
.command-column h3{font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,43px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:10px 0 8px;font-weight:790;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#f6fbfc}
.command-daily h3{font-size:clamp(30px,3vw,43px);margin-top:25px}
.command-message{color:#c1d1d9;line-height:1.6;font-size:15px;max-width:560px;margin:0 0 22px}
.command-action{min-height:52px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;background:#b5f1f2;color:#071b21;padding:12px 22px;border:1px solid #c9f8fa;font-weight:780;letter-spacing:.015em;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:auto}
.command-action:hover{background:#dcfeff;color:#0a2127}
.command-outline{color:#f4dbbd;background:#38291f;border-color:#b78c64}
.command-outline:hover{background:#60462e;color:white}
.directive-status{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:790;color:#edc492;margin:0 0 14px;line-height:1.5}
.directive-status.complete{color:#9aecc5}
.command-footnote{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#9bafb9;margin:16px 0 0;max-width:580px}
/* BLACKBOX two-run comparison */
.compare-desk{margin:26px 0 32px;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,40px);border:1px solid rgba(164,199,216,.31);background:linear-gradient(155deg,#101b25,#090f18 65%);color:#f5f9fb}
.compare-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.compare-heading h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.1vw,58px);line-height:.99;letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:13px 0 12px;font-weight:790;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.compare-heading p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;color:#b5cbd7;margin:0;max-width:680px}
.compare-export{border:1px solid #719aaa;background:#132734;color:#e8f9fb;min-height:48px;padding:11px 16px;font-size:13px;font-weight:750;cursor:pointer}
.compare-export:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}
.compare-export:not(:disabled):hover{background:#214457}
.compare-controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;margin:28px 0 20px}
.compare-controls label,.compare-chart-head label{min-width:0;display:grid;gap:9px;color:#b9ced8;font-weight:750;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.05em}
.compare-controls select,.compare-chart-head select{font-size:14px;min-height:48px;border:1px solid #557482;color:#f2f8fb;background:#142735;padding:10px 12px;max-width:100%;width:100%;cursor:pointer;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.compare-controls select:disabled{opacity:.48}
.compare-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:10px 0 25px}
.compare-stat{min-width:0;background:rgba(12,34,47,.78);border:1px solid rgba(159,207,226,.17);padding:19px 17px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.compare-stat span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#a9c2cf;font-weight:790}
.compare-stat strong{font-size:clamp(18px,2vw,29px);line-height:1.2;font-weight:770;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-.035em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.compare-stat small{font-size:12px;color:#c5d3dc;font-weight:680}
.compare-stat small.better{color:#93e6bd}.compare-stat small.worse{color:#eeb29e}
.compare-chart-head{display:flex;align-items:end;gap:20px;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:15px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.compare-chart-head label{min-width:190px}
.compare-note{max-width:630px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:#b5c4ce;margin:0}
.compare-plot{background:#08131c;border:1px solid #345365;min-width:0;overflow:hidden}
.compare-plot[hidden],.compare-legend[hidden],.compare-content[hidden]{display:none!important}
#compareGraph{width:100%;height:255px;display:block}
.compare-legend{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;margin:12px 0 25px;color:#bdcfda;font-weight:760;font-size:13px}
.compare-legend span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.compare-legend i{display:inline-block;width:25px;height:3px;border-radius:3px}
.compare-line-a{background:#8de1ed}.compare-line-b{background:#efbd88}
.compare-insights{border-top:1px solid rgba(173,208,223,.2);padding-top:23px;margin-top:17px}
.compare-insights h3{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#aecdd9;font-weight:750;margin:0 0 12px}
.compare-insights p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:#f3f5f7;margin:0 0 7px;max-width:800px}
.compare-insights small{display:block;margin-top:16px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;color:#a9bbc6}
.compare-empty{font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:#b8d1de;margin:20px 0 0}
.command-action:focus-visible,.compare-export:focus-visible,.compare-controls select:focus-visible,.compare-chart-head select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #c4f3ff;outline-offset:4px}
/* No horizontal scrolling: large comfortable controls and progressive disclosure. */
@media(max-width:980px){.command-deck{grid-template-columns:1fr}.command-column{min-height:260px}.compare-controls{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.compare-controls label:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}.compare-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:620px){.command-deck{gap:11px;margin-top:12px}.command-column{padding:25px 20px;min-height:280px}.command-daily-head{align-items:start}.command-action{width:100%;font-size:14px;padding:12px}.command-column h3{font-size:clamp(27px,8vw,39px)}.command-message{font-size:15px}.compare-desk{padding:23px 16px;margin:18px 0 24px}.compare-heading h2{font-size:clamp(32px,9vw,42px)}.compare-controls{grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-top:22px}.compare-controls label:first-child{grid-column:auto}.compare-export{width:100%}.compare-stats{gap:7px}.compare-stat{padding:14px 10px}.compare-stat strong{font-size:clamp(17px,5.3vw,25px)}.compare-stat small{font-size:11px}#compareGraph{height:194px}.compare-insights p{font-size:14px}}
@media(max-width:355px){.command-column{padding:20px 15px}.command-progress strong{font-size:38px}.command-progress span{font-size:12px}.compare-desk{padding:19px 12px}.compare-stat{padding:12px 8px}.compare-stat strong{font-size:16px}.compare-stat span{font-size:10px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.command-meter span{transition:none}}
</style>
<style>/* WORLD 2.9 / AEGIS RISK LAB. Diagnostic visualization of actual recorded telemetry. */
.risk-lab[hidden]{display:none!important}
.risk-lab{margin:25px 0;padding:clamp(19px,3vw,36px);background:linear-gradient(120deg,#0c1d28,#0b1720 65%,#101e28);border:1px solid rgba(157,199,216,.30);color:#e9f4f9;min-width:0}
.risk-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.risk-head h3{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,48px);font-weight:830;line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:10px 0}
.risk-head p{max-width:610px;font-size:clamp(13px,1.25vw,16px);line-height:1.6;color:#b7cfdc;margin:4px 0}
.risk-head button{min-height:44px;padding:10px 18px;border:1px solid rgba(174,218,232,.5);color:#e6f6fe;background:#1a3443;cursor:pointer;font:800 12px/1.25 inherit;letter-spacing:.06em}
.risk-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:26px 0 22px}
.risk-stat{background:#08141d;border:1px solid rgba(137,186,201,.22);padding:18px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.risk-stat span{color:#a9c6d3;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;font-weight:760}
.risk-stat strong{font-size:clamp(23px,3vw,40px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.06em;line-height:1.1;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.risk-stat[data-level="3"] strong{color:#ffafa1}
.risk-stat[data-level="2"] strong{color:#f1d1a2}
.risk-timeline-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin:18px 0 13px;color:#a6bfcb;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.risk-timeline-title strong{color:#e9f4f9}
.risk-heatmap{display:flex;gap:2px;width:100%;min-height:42px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:7px}
.risk-slice{flex:1 0 5px;min-width:5px;min-height:36px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);cursor:pointer;transition:filter .14s;background:#28424e}
.risk-slice[data-level="0"]{background:#214c49}.risk-slice[data-level="1"]{background:#426d83}.risk-slice[data-level="2"]{background:#b88a52}.risk-slice[data-level="3"]{background:#c95e54}
.risk-slice:hover,.risk-slice:focus-visible{filter:brightness(1.5);outline:2px solid white;outline-offset:1px}
.risk-transitions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px;margin-top:18px}
.risk-transition{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(124,175,198,.22);background:#0a1922}
.risk-transition time{color:#b0d6e7;flex:none;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:800}
.risk-transition span{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:#dfedf3}
.risk-transition[data-level="3"]{border-left:3px solid #f08a75}.risk-transition[data-level="2"]{border-left:3px solid #e0b37b}
.risk-note{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#a3bfcc;margin:19px 0 0}
@media(max-width:660px){.risk-stats{gap:6px}.risk-stat{padding:12px 9px}.risk-stat strong{font-size:21px}.risk-transitions{grid-template-columns:1fr}.risk-head button{width:100%}.risk-lab{padding:16px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.risk-slice{transition:none}}
</style>
<style>/* SABLEFAULT WORLD 3.0 — BLACKSITE CAMPAIGN, authored editorial interface.
   Does not depend on external assets, fonts or images. */
.story-home-cta{min-height:52px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.035em;border-color:#b18a5b;color:#ffe3bc;background:rgba(109,73,37,.22)}
.story-home-cta:hover{background:rgba(168,118,59,.30);border-color:#f1c996}
.story-campaign{margin:0 0 clamp(32px,5vw,64px);color:#f4f5f5;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#15212b 0%,#0c151e 44%,#080f16 100%);border:1px solid #49606e;box-shadow:0 35px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.23);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.story-campaign:before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-190px;right:-100px;width:650px;height:650px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(226,181,111,.11);box-shadow:0 0 0 70px rgba(226,181,111,.025),0 0 0 160px rgba(155,202,212,.018);pointer-events:none}
.story-campaign-header{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;padding:clamp(23px,4vw,50px);padding-bottom:30px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(167,199,213,.18)}
.story-marker,.story-act-label,.story-route-eyebrow,.story-log-label{display:block;color:#e7c18b;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:800}
.story-campaign-header h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.7vw,71px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.057em;font-weight:790;max-width:960px;margin:17px 0 15px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.story-campaign-header p{max-width:730px;color:#c1d1da;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;margin:0}
.story-progress-block{flex:0 0 150px;max-width:150px;text-align:right}
.story-progress-block strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,48px);line-height:1;color:#f4e6ca;letter-spacing:-.055em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.story-progress-track{width:100%;height:6px;background:#253942;margin-top:18px;overflow:hidden}
.story-progress-track span{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#87d8dd,#eac185);transition:width .3s ease}
.story-campaign-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(270px,35%) minmax(0,1fr)}
.story-route-panel{border-right:1px solid rgba(167,199,213,.18);padding:30px clamp(20px,3vw,36px);background:rgba(5,12,19,.3)}
.story-route-eyebrow{color:#95b6c1;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:21px}
.story-route{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.story-route-row{min-height:0;min-width:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px minmax(0,1fr);gap:5px 10px;align-items:center;padding:12px 12px 12px 13px;border-left:2px solid transparent;background:rgba(130,166,182,.025)}
.story-route-index{font-size:12px;color:#8eb0bb;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:800}
.story-route-name{color:#b9cbd3;font-size:clamp(13px,1.35vw,15px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.012em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.story-route-state{grid-column:2;color:#8299a3;font-size:10px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:.1em}
.story-route-row.done{border-color:#6bc2be;background:rgba(90,177,179,.09)}.story-route-row.done .story-route-name{color:#d3f3eb}.story-route-row.done .story-route-state{color:#9bdfcb}
.story-route-row.active{border-color:#eac185;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(192,145,83,.16),rgba(192,145,83,.02))}.story-route-row.active .story-route-name{color:#fff}.story-route-row.active .story-route-index,.story-route-row.active .story-route-state{color:#f0c993}
.story-chapter-panel{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:clamp(23px,4vw,52px);min-height:570px;position:relative}
.story-act-label{color:#9ce0e7;padding-bottom:26px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(159,203,213,.18)}
.story-log-label{color:#91abb8;margin:30px 0 14px;font-size:10px}
.story-chapter-panel h3{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,51px);line-height:1.08;font-weight:790;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:0 0 18px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.story-narrative,.story-choices>p,.story-epilogue>p{font-size:clamp(16px,1.55vw,19px);color:#d0dce1;line-height:1.7;max-width:750px}
.story-voice{border-left:3px solid #dba96d;margin:30px 0 16px;padding:6px 0 6px 24px;font-size:clamp(16px,1.7vw,21px);line-height:1.55;color:#f1e0c8;font-style:italic;max-width:750px}
.story-continuity{max-width:750px;font-size:14px;color:#a5d2d4;line-height:1.6}
.story-choices{padding:28px 0}.story-choices h3{color:#f8deba}.story-choice-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:25px}
.story-choice-grid button{min-height:86px;text-align:left;padding:20px;border:1px solid #b89161;background:#3c2f27;color:#ffe2b8;font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.story-choice-grid button:hover{background:#62442b;border-color:#ffe0ac}
.story-epilogue{padding:28px 0}.story-epilogue span{color:#a4f1d6;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.13em;font-weight:800}.story-epilogue h3{font-size:clamp(39px,5vw,65px);margin:18px 0 20px}
.story-footer-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:auto;padding-top:24px}
.story-main-button,.story-outline-button,.story-quiet-button{min-height:52px;border:1px solid #8fc5ca;padding:12px 19px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;cursor:pointer}
.story-main-button{background:#b8edf0;border-color:#c6ffff;color:#06232d}.story-main-button:hover{background:#e0fbfd}
.story-outline-button{background:#1d313e;color:#d0f1f0}.story-outline-button:hover{background:#284557}
.story-quiet-button{color:#d9c0a0;background:transparent;border-color:#5e6264}.story-quiet-button:hover{border-color:#d1af85;color:#fff}
.story-disclaimer{font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:#adc0c7;margin:0;padding:16px clamp(23px,4vw,50px);border-top:1px solid rgba(159,203,213,.12)}
.story-choices .story-disclaimer{border:0;margin-top:15px;padding:0;color:#bec8cd}
.story-campaign :is(button):focus-visible{outline:3px solid #efcc92;outline-offset:4px}
@media(max-width:1050px){.story-campaign-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,33%) minmax(0,1fr)}.story-route-panel{padding:24px 16px}.story-chapter-panel{padding:25px}.story-voice{margin-top:22px}.story-choice-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.story-choice-grid button{min-height:64px}}
@media(max-width:750px){.story-campaign-header{display:block;padding:25px 20px}.story-progress-block{text-align:left;max-width:100%;margin-top:24px}.story-progress-block strong{font-size:39px}.story-progress-track{margin-top:8px}.story-campaign-layout{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.story-route-panel{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(167,199,213,.18);padding:22px 19px}.story-route{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px}.story-route-row{padding:10px 8px;grid-template-columns:23px minmax(0,1fr);gap:3px 5px}.story-route-name{font-size:12px}.story-route-state{font-size:9px}.story-chapter-panel{min-height:490px;padding:25px 20px}.story-main-button,.story-outline-button,.story-quiet-button{width:100%}.story-campaign-header h2{font-size:clamp(30px,8vw,46px)}.story-campaign-header p{font-size:15px}.story-narrative,.story-choices>p,.story-epilogue>p{font-size:16px}}
@media(max-width:365px){.story-route-row{grid-template-columns:20px minmax(0,1fr)}.story-route-index{font-size:10px}.story-route-name{font-size:11px}.story-route-state{font-size:8px}.story-route-panel{padding:18px 12px}.story-chapter-panel{padding:23px 15px}.story-campaign-header{padding:20px 15px}.story-voice{padding-left:14px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.story-progress-track span{transition:none}}
</style>
<style>/* WORLD 3.1 TRANSIT SPINE. No raster art or embedded promotional imagery. */
.transit-entry{margin:22px 0 6px;padding:24px;border:1px solid rgba(148,195,213,.33);background:linear-gradient(115deg,#0b1723,#0c1c27 55%,#17242c);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.transit-entry:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#82d4e2,transparent 55%,#edaa74)}
.transit-entry-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.transit-entry-kicker{font:700 11px/1.3 ui-monospace,monospace;color:#9bd9e3;letter-spacing:.17em}
.transit-entry h3{font-size:clamp(28px,3.8vw,55px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:11px 0;color:#f4f7fa;font-weight:850}
.transit-entry p{color:#acbdc9;font-size:14px;max-width:60ch;margin:0}
.transit-acts{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}
.transit-act{display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;gap:7px;flex:1;min-width:140px;border:1px solid rgba(139,190,211,.28);background:rgba(16,31,43,.95);color:#f0f5f6;min-height:88px;padding:17px;cursor:pointer}
.transit-act strong{font:750 13px/1.3 ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em}
.transit-act span{font:600 10px/1.2 ui-monospace,monospace;color:#9fc0d0;letter-spacing:.08em}
.transit-act:hover:not(:disabled),.transit-act:focus-visible{border-color:#95ecfa;background:rgba(35,62,79,.95);outline:0}
.transit-act:disabled{opacity:.36;cursor:not-allowed}
.transit-act.completed{border-color:rgba(118,208,188,.48)}
.transit-overlay[hidden],.transit-complete[hidden]{display:none!important}
.transit-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;background:#050b11;color:#e9f1f6;display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}
.transit-overlay *{box-sizing:border-box}
.transit-top{height:75px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:center;padding:15px clamp(16px,3.6vw,56px);background:#0b1521;border-bottom:1px solid #294354;z-index:4}
.transit-top .transit-ident{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;min-width:0}
.transit-symbol{display:block;width:34px;height:34px;border:2px solid #7bd9ee;transform:rotate(45deg);box-shadow:0 0 15px #4595ad33}
.transit-top span{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#8da8b9;font-weight:720}
.transit-top strong{display:block;font-weight:870;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,19px);color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.transit-exit{background:transparent;border:1px solid #64869a;color:#e8f2f7;min-height:42px;padding:0 15px;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:.09em}
.transit-exit:hover,.transit-exit:focus-visible{background:#183347;outline:2px solid #75d6ec}
.transit-stage{position:relative;min-height:0;flex:1;background:#060d14;overflow:hidden}
.transit-stage canvas{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none;outline:none}
.transit-stage:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(4,13,22,.35),transparent 21%,transparent 69%,rgba(3,9,17,.55))}
.transit-crosshair{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:24px;height:24px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;z-index:2}
.transit-crosshair:before,.transit-crosshair:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:11px;top:0;width:2px;height:24px;background:#9dddedb0}
.transit-crosshair:after{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.transit-topline,.transit-sidepanel,.transit-telemetry,.transit-hint{position:absolute;z-index:3;pointer-events:none}
.transit-topline{top:27px;left:clamp(16px,4vw,58px);max-width:460px}
.transit-topline>span,.transit-sidepanel>span,.transit-telemetry span{font-size:11px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8ebdcf}
.transit-topline h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4.3vw,65px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:10px 0 12px;color:#edf5fa;text-shadow:0 2px 22px #000}
.transit-topline p{font-size:13px;color:#bed4df;line-height:1.55;max-width:380px;text-shadow:0 1px 10px #000}
.transit-sidepanel{right:clamp(16px,3.8vw,56px);top:28px;border:1px solid #41657a88;background:#0b1924cc;padding:20px;width:min(278px,35vw);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.transit-sidepanel strong{display:block;font:740 13px/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace;margin:13px 0;color:#f7f9fa;letter-spacing:.05em}
.transit-next{padding:10px;background:#183241;color:#a7e2ee!important}
.transit-telemetry{bottom:25px;left:clamp(16px,4vw,58px);display:flex;gap:7px}
.transit-telemetry div{background:#071421de;padding:10px 15px;border:1px solid #2d4659;min-width:98px}
.transit-telemetry strong{display:block;font:780 25px/1.45 ui-monospace,monospace;color:#fff}
.transit-hint{left:50%;bottom:44px;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(420px,65%);text-align:center}
.transit-hint strong{display:block;background:#0a1e2ae8;border:1px solid #3b738a;padding:10px 16px;font:700 11px/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.07em;color:#e2f5fb}
.transit-hint small{display:block;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 1px 7px #000;margin-top:7px}
.transit-actions{position:absolute;bottom:24px;right:clamp(18px,3.8vw,56px);z-index:4;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:end;gap:9px}
.transit-action{background:#bbdfe7;color:#091b26;font-weight:850;border:0;padding:15px 20px;cursor:pointer;min-height:52px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.07em}
.transit-action:hover{background:#fff}
.transit-actions small{font:650 10px/1.2 ui-monospace,monospace;color:#b3c9d3;letter-spacing:.07em}
.transit-touch{position:relative;z-index:4;display:none;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:12px;background:#0a1521;border-top:1px solid #294353}
.transit-move,.transit-look{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,48px);grid-template-rows:repeat(2,44px);gap:5px}
.transit-look{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,64px);grid-template-rows:repeat(2,44px)}
.transit-touch button{border:1px solid #446175;border-radius:4px;background:#1d3445;color:#e1eff4;touch-action:none;user-select:none;font-size:10px;font-weight:750;min-width:44px}
.transit-touch button:active{background:#447083}
.transit-move [data-transit-hold="w"]{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}
.transit-move [data-transit-hold="a"]{grid-column:1;grid-row:2}
.transit-move [data-transit-hold="s"]{grid-column:2;grid-row:2}
.transit-move [data-transit-hold="d"]{grid-column:3;grid-row:2}
.transit-complete{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:10;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#040c14e8;backdrop-filter:blur(9px);padding:20px}
.transit-complete-panel{width:min(510px,100%);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#10222c,#09131f);padding:clamp(24px,4vw,48px);border:1px solid #6bbec3}
.transit-complete-panel span{font:700 11px ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#9edbe5}
.transit-complete-panel h2{font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,68px);line-height:1.0;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:15px 0}
.transit-complete-panel p{color:#bacfdb;line-height:1.6}
.transit-complete-panel strong{display:block;font:700 16px ui-monospace,monospace;color:#fff;margin-top:18px}
.transit-complete-panel div:last-child{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:26px}
.transit-complete-panel button{border:1px solid #80b6c5;background:#182e3d;color:#fff;min-height:46px;padding:12px 16px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:720}
.transit-complete-panel button:last-child{background:#d5edf0;color:#071722}
@media(max-width:950px){.transit-sidepanel{top:auto;bottom:120px;left:16px;right:auto;width:min(270px,44vw)}.transit-topline{top:13px}.transit-topline h2{font-size:31px}.transit-topline p{display:none}}
@media(max-width:700px),(pointer:coarse){.transit-top{height:60px;padding:8px 12px}.transit-symbol{width:22px;height:22px}.transit-top span{font-size:8px}.transit-exit{max-width:145px;padding:0 8px;font-size:9px}.transit-sidepanel{top:8px;right:8px;left:auto;width:145px;padding:10px;bottom:auto}.transit-sidepanel strong{font-size:10px;margin:7px 0}.transit-topline{left:10px;top:12px;max-width:calc(100% - 170px)}.transit-topline h2{font-size:24px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.transit-topline>span{font-size:9px}.transit-telemetry{left:8px;bottom:9px}.transit-telemetry div{min-width:64px;padding:6px 8px}.transit-telemetry strong{font-size:17px}.transit-telemetry span{font-size:8px}.transit-hint{bottom:95px;width:calc(100% - 18px)}.transit-hint small{display:none}.transit-actions{bottom:9px;right:8px}.transit-action{min-height:40px;padding:9px;font-size:9px}.transit-actions small{display:none}.transit-touch{display:flex}.transit-overlay{height:100dvh}.transit-crosshair{opacity:.55}}
@media(max-width:360px){.transit-move{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,40px)}.transit-look{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,52px)}.transit-telemetry div{min-width:56px}.transit-topline h2{font-size:21px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.transit-overlay *{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}
</style>
<style>/* SABLEFAULT WORLD 3.2 — playable second chamber; authored CSS, no image generation. */
.breach32-entry{margin:28px 0 28px;padding:clamp(20px,4vw,44px);border:1px solid rgba(176,151,244,.32);background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 92% 8%,rgba(78,64,137,.19),transparent 48%),linear-gradient(112deg,#0a1522,#11172b 54%,#181522);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.breach32-entry:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9bb6fa,#9779f4,transparent)}
.breach32-entry h3{font-size:clamp(30px,4.4vw,65px);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.065em;color:#f5f2ff;margin:10px 0 14px}
.breach32-entry p{color:#c1c4d7;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;max-width:68ch;margin:0}
.breach32-entry .transit-entry-kicker{color:#bcaafb}
.breach32-diagram{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:26px 0 21px;color:#d6d4ef;font:700 10px/1.3 ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;flex-wrap:wrap}
.breach32-diagram i{width:28px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7a709e,#c9c4f8)}
.breach32-act{border-color:rgba(159,138,226,.35);background:rgba(23,24,49,.85)}
.breach32-act:hover:not(:disabled),.breach32-act:focus-visible{border-color:#c6aeff;background:#29294d}
.breach32-act.completed{border-color:#a5dddc}
.breach32-head-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.breach32-phase-panel[hidden]{display:none!important}
.breach32-phase-panel{position:absolute;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;right:clamp(16px,3.8vw,56px);top:196px;width:min(278px,35vw);border:1px solid #8476b788;background:rgba(22,22,45,.88);padding:17px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.breach32-phase-panel span{font:750 10px/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace;color:#b9b0f1;letter-spacing:.11em}
.breach32-phase-panel strong{font:700 15px/1.9 ui-monospace,monospace;display:block;margin-top:10px;color:#f1ebff}
.breach32-phase-panel small{display:block;color:#bbcbdf;font:600 10px/1.5 ui-monospace,monospace;margin-top:8px}
@media(max-width:900px){.breach32-phase-panel{top:auto;bottom:195px;right:12px;width:175px;padding:10px}.breach32-phase-panel strong{font-size:11px;margin-top:5px}.breach32-phase-panel small{font-size:9px}}
@media(max-width:700px),(pointer:coarse){.breach32-head-actions .transit-exit{max-width:145px;font-size:9px;min-height:36px}.breach32-head-actions{gap:5px}.breach32-phase-panel{top:auto;bottom:78px;right:8px;width:150px}.breach32-phase-panel strong{font-size:10px}.breach32-phase-panel small{display:none}.breach32-diagram{gap:6px;font-size:9px}.breach32-diagram i{width:12px}}
@media(max-width:360px){.breach32-head-actions .transit-exit{max-width:112px;padding:0 5px}.breach32-phase-panel{bottom:80px}}

/* Mobile release polish: no clipped renderer title or overlapping controls. */
@media(max-width:700px),(pointer:coarse){
 .transit-top{height:66px;min-height:66px;gap:4px;padding:7px 8px}
 .transit-top .transit-ident{gap:7px;max-width:126px;min-width:0}
 .transit-top .transit-ident>div{min-width:0}
 .transit-top .transit-ident span{display:none}
 .transit-top .transit-ident strong{font-size:11px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:0;white-space:normal;overflow:visible;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
 .transit-symbol{height:16px;width:16px;flex-shrink:0}
 .breach32-head-actions{gap:4px;flex-wrap:nowrap;flex-shrink:0}
 .breach32-head-actions .transit-exit{max-width:86px;min-height:40px;padding:4px 6px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:0;white-space:normal}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.transit-top .transit-ident{max-width:119px}.breach32-head-actions .transit-exit{max-width:83px;font-size:8px}}
.transit-overlay:has(.transit-complete:not([hidden])) .transit-crosshair{display:none}
@media(max-width:700px),(pointer:coarse){.transit-overlay:has(.transit-complete:not([hidden])) .transit-touch{display:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<a class="skip" data-copy="skip" href="#content">К содержанию</a>
<div class="world-frame" id="worldApp">
<header class="world-header">
<button aria-label="SABLEFAULT — главная" class="wordmark" id="brandHome" type="button">
<span aria-hidden="true" class="mark-icon"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>
<span>SABLE<span class="dim">FAULT</span><b class="brand-point">.</b></span>
</button>
<nav aria-label="Навигация" class="nav">
<button aria-current="page" class="active" data-copy="navHome" data-nav="home" type="button">Обзор</button>
<button data-copy="navMissions" data-nav="missions" type="button">Эпизоды</button>
<button data-copy="navArchive" data-nav="archive" type="button">Архив</button>
<button data-copy="navSettings" data-nav="settings" type="button">Настройки</button>
</nav>
<div class="header-actions">
<span class="status-connection"><i></i><span data-copy="local">ЛОКАЛЬНЫЙ ПРОФИЛЬ</span></span>
<button aria-label="Switch language" class="language-button" id="langToggle" type="button">EN</button>
<button aria-controls="mobileNavPanel" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Меню" class="mobile-nav-button" id="mobileNav" type="button">☰</button>
</div>
</header>
<div class="mobile-nav-panel" hidden="" id="mobileNavPanel">
<button data-copy="navHome" data-nav="home" type="button">Обзор</button>
<button data-copy="navMissions" data-nav="missions" type="button">Эпизоды</button>
<button data-copy="navArchive" data-nav="archive" type="button">Архив</button>
<button data-copy="navSettings" data-nav="settings" type="button">Настройки</button>
</div>
<main id="content">
<section aria-label="SABLEFAULT WORLD" class="view" id="homeView">
<div class="hero">
<div aria-hidden="true" class="hero-art"><img alt="" draggable="false" src="data:image/svg+xml;base64,"/></div>
<div aria-hidden="true" class="hero-shade"></div>
<div class="hero-content">
<div class="eyeline"><span class="red-dot"></span><span data-copy="heroEyebrow">ОРИГИНАЛЬНЫЙ НАУЧНО-ФАНТАСТИЧЕСКИЙ ТРИЛЛЕР</span><span class="eyeline-nb"> / 01</span></div>
<h1 aria-label="SABLEFAULT" class="hero-title"><span>SABLE</span><span>FAULT<span class="title-dot">.</span></span></h1>
<p class="hero-tag" data-copy="heroTag">У КАЖДОЙ СИСТЕМЫ ЕСТЬ ПРЕДЕЛ.</p>
<p class="hero-description" data-copy="heroDescription">Под ледяными горами скрыт реакторный комплекс. Восемь операций, три финала и решения, которые меняют весь комплекс.</p>
<div class="hero-actions">
<button class="button-secondary story-home-cta" id="storyCampaignHome" type="button">СЮЖЕТНАЯ КАМПАНИЯ ↗</button>
<button class="button-primary" id="heroPlay" type="button"><span data-copy="playNow">НАЧАТЬ ИНЦИДЕНТ</span><span aria-hidden="true" class="button-arrow">↗</span></button>
<button class="button-secondary" data-copy="continueNow" hidden="" id="heroContinue" type="button">ПРОДОЛЖИТЬ</button>
</div>
<div class="hero-proof"><span data-copy="proofAlpha">ИГРАЕМАЯ ALPHA / v1.6</span><span class="proof-line"></span><span>RU / EN</span><span class="proof-line"></span><span>WEB / OFFLINE</span></div>
</div>
<div aria-hidden="true" class="hero-side"><span>AEGIS // BLACKSITE 09</span><strong>01 / POLAR ARRAY</strong><span>CONTROL — SURVIVE — UNCOVER</span></div>
<div class="hero-bottom"><span data-copy="heroBottom">ОПЕРАЦИЯ // SECTOR 09</span><span>69° 14′ N / 028° 03′ E <span class="muted">·</span> FICTIONAL</span></div>
</div>
<div class="section-label"><span data-copy="liveSystem">ДОСТУПНО СЕЙЧАС</span><i></i><span>08 / LIVE</span></div>
<section aria-label="Доступный контент" class="feature-grid">
<article class="feature-wide">
<div class="feature-copy"><span class="kicker">PLAYABLE / 01</span><h2 data-copy="featureTitle">РЕАКТОРНЫЙ<br/>ПРОТОКОЛ</h2><p data-copy="featureText">От перегрева до эвакуации. Каждое решение меняет состояние комплекса.</p><button class="text-button" id="featurePlay" type="button"><span data-copy="enterSector">ВОЙТИ В СЕКТОР</span><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></div>
<div aria-hidden="true" class="feature-visual"><div class="reactor-sculpt"><div class="reactor-outer"></div><div class="reactor-second"></div><div class="reactor-core"></div><div class="reactor-beam"></div></div></div>
</article>
<article class="feature-compact"><div><span class="kicker">CHALLENGE / 02</span><h2>RED<span class="red">LINE</span></h2><p data-copy="redlineText">Три минуты. Более жёсткий кризис. Отдельный прогресс.</p></div><button class="text-button" id="featureRedline" type="button"><span data-copy="takeChallenge">ПРИНЯТЬ ВЫЗОВ</span><span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></button></article>
</section>
<section aria-label="Восемь действующих операций" class="campaign">
<div class="campaign-intro"><span class="kicker" data-copy="campaignLabel">ПУТЬ ОПЕРАТОРА</span>
<h2 data-copy="campaignTitle">ВОСЕМЬ ОПЕРАЦИЙ.<br/>ОДИН КОМПЛЕКС.</h2>
<p data-copy="campaignHint">Пройденные миссии отмечаются по настоящим результатам, но запуск любой операции доступен без блокировок.</p>
</div>
<div aria-live="polite" class="campaign-sequence" id="campaignSequence"></div>
<section aria-label="Crisis Command" class="command-deck">
<div class="command-column">
<span class="command-kicker" data-copy="commandLabel">CRISIS COMMAND / МАРШРУТ КОМПЛЕКСА</span>
<div class="command-progress"><strong id="commandProgress">0 / 8</strong><span data-copy="commandOperations">операций завершено в текущем досье</span></div>
<div aria-label="Completed operations" aria-valuemax="8" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuenow="0" class="command-meter" id="commandMeter" role="progressbar"><span id="commandMeterFill"></span></div>
<span class="command-muted" data-copy="commandNextLabel">СЛЕДУЮЩИЙ ПРОТОКОЛ</span>
<h3 id="commandNext">CONTAINMENT</h3>
<p class="command-message" id="commandSummary"></p>
<button class="command-action" data-copy="commandPlay" id="commandLaunch" type="button">ОТКРЫТЬ ОПЕРАЦИЮ ↗</button>
</div>
<div class="command-column command-daily">
<div class="command-daily-head"><span class="command-kicker" data-copy="directiveLabel">ЕЖЕДНЕВНАЯ ДИРЕКТИВА / UTC</span><time id="directiveDay"></time></div>
<h3 id="directiveTitle">—</h3>
<p class="command-message" id="directiveGoal"></p>
<p aria-live="polite" class="directive-status" id="directiveProgress" role="status"></p>
<button class="command-action command-outline" data-copy="directivePlay" id="directiveLaunch" type="button">ВЫПОЛНИТЬ ДИРЕКТИВУ ↗</button>
<p class="command-footnote" data-copy="directiveDisclaimer">Цель проверяется по локальным записям за UTC-день. Директива не меняет физику игры и не является онлайн-рейтингом.</p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section aria-label="Об игровом мире" class="signature"><span class="kicker" data-copy="signatureKicker">СИСТЕМА ОТВЕЧАЕТ НА КАЖДОЕ ДЕЙСТВИЕ</span><p data-copy="signatureText">Не наблюдай за катастрофой. <em>Управляй её последствиями.</em></p><div class="signature-facts"><span>14 <small data-copy="stations">ТЕРМИНАЛОВ</small></span><span>03 <small data-copy="endings">ФИНАЛА</small></span><span>08 <small data-copy="modes">РЕЖИМОВ</small></span></div></section>
</section>
<section aria-label="Эпизоды" class="view" hidden="" id="missionsView">
<div class="page-intro"><span class="kicker" data-copy="missionEyebrow">ОПЕРАЦИИ / СЕКТОР 09</span><h1 data-copy="missionsTitle">ВЫБЕРИ СВОЙ<br/><em>ПРОТОКОЛ.</em></h1><p data-copy="missionsLead">Семь протоколов, четыре технологических крыла и разные игровые механики. Каждый результат сохраняется в локальном досье.</p></div>
<section aria-label="Blacksite story campaign" aria-labelledby="storyCampaignTitle" class="story-campaign" id="storyCampaign">
<header class="story-campaign-header">
<div><span class="story-marker" id="storyCampaignMarker">BLACKSITE CAMPAIGN / СЮЖЕТНАЯ ЛИНИЯ</span>
<h2 id="storyCampaignTitle">ПОСЛЕДНЯЯ НОЧЬ ПОЛЯРНОГО КОМПЛЕКСА</h2>
<p id="storyCampaignLead">Три акта. Восемь игровых операций. Два решения и четыре финала.</p></div>
<div class="story-progress-block"><strong aria-label="Campaign missions completed" id="storyCampaignProgress">0 / 8</strong><div aria-label="Campaign progression" aria-valuemax="8" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuenow="0" class="story-progress-track" id="storyCampaignMeter" role="progressbar"><span id="storyCampaignMeterFill"></span></div></div>
</header>
<div class="story-campaign-layout">
<div class="story-route-panel"><span class="story-route-eyebrow" id="storyCampaignRouteLabel">МАРШРУТ ОПЕРАЦИЙ</span><div aria-label="Narrative operation sequence" class="story-route" id="storyCampaignRoute" role="list"></div></div>
<div aria-live="polite" class="story-chapter-panel">
<span class="story-act-label" id="storyCampaignAct">АКТ 01 / ПЕРВЫЙ СИГНАЛ</span>
<div id="storyCampaignBriefing">
<span class="story-log-label" id="storyCampaignLogLabel">ПЕРЕХВАЧЕННЫЙ БОРТОВОЙ ЖУРНАЛ</span>
<h3 id="storyCampaignScene">01 / КРИТИЧЕСКИЙ КОНТУР</h3>
<p class="story-narrative" id="storyCampaignLog"></p>
<blockquote class="story-voice" id="storyCampaignDialogue"></blockquote>

<script>/* SABLEFAULT WORLD 3.0 / RISK SIGNALS
   Shared, deterministic classifications for fictional game telemetry only.
   NOT an engineering simulator, real-world safety forecast or tamper-proof report.
   Does not modify simulation state, gameplay physics, save data or browser storage. */
(function(root){
  'use strict';
  const keys=['heat','pressure','power','oxygen','stress'];
  const limits={heat:[64,77,92],pressure:[64,77,92],power:[40,22,9],oxygen:[42,25,12],stress:[2,4,7]};
  function level(key,value){
    if(!keys.includes(key)||!Number.isFinite(value))return 0;
    const [watch,high,critical]=limits[key];
    if(key==='power'||key==='oxygen')return value<=critical?3:value<=high?2:value<=watch?1:0;
    return value>=critical?3:value>=high?2:value>=watch?1:0;
  }
  function classify(row){
    if(!Array.isArray(row)||row.length!==7||row.some(x=>!Number.isFinite(x)))return {level:0,drivers:[],valid:false};
    const drivers=[];
    keys.forEach((key,i)=>{const severity=level(key,row[i+1]);if(severity)drivers.push({key,severity,value:row[i+1]});});
    drivers.sort((a,b)=>b.severity-a.severity||keys.indexOf(a.key)-keys.indexOf(b.key));
    return {level:drivers[0]?.severity||0,drivers,valid:true};
  }
  function summarize(flight){
    if(!flight||!Array.isArray(flight.samples)||!flight.samples.length)return null;
    const counts=[0,0,0,0],transitions=[];
    let prevLevel=null,valid=0,criticalFirst=null,watchFirst=null,peak=0;
    const peaks={heat:0,pressure:0,power:100,oxygen:100,stress:0};
    for(const row of flight.samples){
      const result=classify(row);if(!result.valid)continue;
      valid++;counts[result.level]++;peak=Math.max(peak,result.level);
      peaks.heat=Math.max(peaks.heat,row[1]);peaks.pressure=Math.max(peaks.pressure,row[2]);
      peaks.power=Math.min(peaks.power,row[3]);peaks.oxygen=Math.min(peaks.oxygen,row[4]);peaks.stress=Math.max(peaks.stress,row[5]);
      if(result.level>=2&&criticalFirst===null)criticalFirst=row[0];
      if(result.level>=1&&watchFirst===null)watchFirst=row[0];
      if(prevLevel!==null&&result.level!==prevLevel){
        transitions.push({at:row[0],from:prevLevel,to:result.level,drivers:result.drivers.slice(0,2).map(x=>x.key)});
      }
      prevLevel=result.level;
    }
    if(!valid)return null;
    return {schema:1,method:'thresholds-on-recorded-samples',sampleCount:valid,counts,peak,criticalFirst,watchFirst,
      transitions:transitions.slice(0,40),peaks,partial:flight.partial===true,
      firstAt:flight.samples[0][0],lastAt:flight.samples[flight.samples.length-1][0],
      note:'Sample classifications, not continuous exposure, a replay, a diagnosis, or server-verified evidence.'};
  }
  Object.values(limits).forEach(Object.freeze);
  const api=Object.freeze({version:'3.0.0',level,classify,summarize,limits:Object.freeze(limits)});
  Object.defineProperty(root,'SABLEFAULT_RISK_29',{configurable:false,enumerable:false,writable:false,value:api});
})(window);
</script>
